title: Synthetic acoustic link and single-echo study
hypothesis: Under fixed-noise geometric-loss assumptions, increasing distance lowers Eb/N0 and raises ideal BPSK error probability.
differentiation: No novel acoustic method is claimed. This example demonstrates reproducibility and evidence organization; a literature and program overlap review is still required.

link.assumption_reference: Illustrative constant-speed medium and ideal coherent baseband AWGN; not a calibrated acoustic channel

ranging.assumption_reference: Synthetic known bipolar pulse, one positive echo and independent Gaussian noise; no detector threshold
